title: Vertical blockade
where: Same pathway; squeeze from above and below
best_readout: glecirasib + sitneprotafib/JAB-3312 (SHP2), first-line KRAS G12C NSCLC: ORR 71% (n=72, 95% CI 61-79); 49% (n=39, 32-65) if previously treated
ceiling: Deeper suppression drives more extreme escape routes: SHP2/MEK co-inhibition creates a GPX4 dependency

title: Horizontal blockade
best_readout: sotorasib + panitumumab in CRC, third line (phase 3 CodeBreaK 300): PFS 5.6 vs 2.2 months; EGFR must be blocked first
ceiling: Neither across lines nor to survival: adagrasib + cetuximab (KRYSTAL-10) improved neither PFS nor OS and that approval was withdrawn in Sep 2026; CodeBreaK 300 OS HR 0.70 missed the 0.01875 threshold

title: Combined immunotherapy
best_readout: Starting checkpoint therapy shortly before MAPK-targeted therapy prolongs the durability of regression, not the response rate
ceiling: Toxicity sits on the same variable: severe hepatotoxicity 33% vs 11% in the sequence group (retrospective)

title: State and stress
best_readout: ifebemtinib (FAK) + garsorasib, first-line KRAS G12C NSCLC: confirmed ORR 82% (27 of 33, 95% CI 64.5-93.0); grade 3-4 AE 33%
ceiling: Fewest clinical readouts of the four; senescence is an intermediate state that raises a GPX4 brake and needs a second step

title: Cytotoxic combination
where: Off the axis: another killing mechanism, no node relation to RAS signalling
best_readout: sotorasib + carboplatin/pemetrexed, first line: ORR 88.9%, median PFS 6.6 months (95% CI 5.3-16.7), median OS 20.6 months
ceiling: Single-arm, 30 patients, pre-set interval; crossover in the phase 3 trials means their design cannot answer the combination question
